									&lt;img alt=&quot;Image_2026-10-08_13-35-42.png&quot; src=&quot;https://mastercam.file.force.com/sfc/servlet.shepherd/version/download/068Uv00000gpw3N?asPdf=false&amp;amp;operationContext=CHATTER&quot; style=&quot;max-width: 635.6543121337891px&quot; title=&quot;Image_2026-10-08_13-35-42.png&quot;&gt;&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
									&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
									GM2&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
									&lt;img alt=&quot;Image_2026-10-08_13-36-34.png&quot; src=&quot;https://mastercam.file.force.com/sfc/servlet.shepherd/version/download/068Uv00000gpYCS?asPdf=false&amp;amp;operationContext=CHATTER&quot; style=&quot;max-width: 635.6543121337891px&quot; title=&quot;Image_2026-10-08_13-36-34.png&quot;&gt;&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
									&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
									Millenium VR14&lt;/p&gt;

									&lt;p&gt;&lt;img alt=&quot;Image_2026-10-08_13-37-21.png&quot; src=&quot;https://mastercam.file.force.com/sfc/servlet.shepherd/version/download/068Uv00000gpX3T?asPdf=false&amp;amp;operationContext=CHATTER&quot; style=&quot;max-width: 635.6543121337891px&quot; title=&quot;Image_2026-10-08_13-37-21.png&quot;&gt;&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
									&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
									The Millenium is missing IJK and G253, but&amp;nbsp;this is&amp;nbsp;&lt;em&gt;another&lt;/em&gt;&amp;nbsp;documented way to define TWP on these machines, so I'm still not clear if that's the missing piece here.&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
									&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
									Alarm 308 indicates an invalid tool offset.&amp;nbsp; Going back to your screenshot from Sep-22 (https://photos.app.goo.gl/kXz7DJhvBSSt1CwZ8), it is highlighting G253, which is after the G234 H22 line, which may indicate there is no tool offset defined for 22.&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
									&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
									Please provide working edited code for 5-axis drilling along with the MCAM, if I don't have it already, so we're on the same page.&amp;nbsp; If the Millenium code works, we can certainly do the exact same thing here.&amp;nbsp; I will address defaulting misc real 1 at that time as well.&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;

I cut it to 5 to see if an extreme value would help and it made the machine behave different but not better.&amp;nbsp;Maybe not as large stutters but more of them if that makes sense.&amp;nbsp;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;img src=&quot;/sfc/servlet.shepherd/version/download/068Uv00000d4N7h?asPdf=false&amp;amp;operationContext=CHATTER&quot; alt=&quot;image.png&quot; width=&quot;503&quot; height=&quot;523&quot;&gt;&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;Maximum Rotary Axis Feed Rate: I set this to equiv of 110 degree a sec, max feed of b axis.
